meta.title: Loadout
meta.description: Choose which skills and rules your agents carry. Open Loadout in the left sidebar to set each skill to On, Manual (hidden from the model, still available as /name), or Off, and switch rule files on or off: global ones from ~/.dsh/rules and ~/.agents/rules, and per-workspace ones from .agents/rules. Enabled rules are added to the agent context next to AGENTS.md, subagents included. Choices are saved to ~/.agents/loadout.json and <project>/.agents/loadout.json, so they can be committed. The Instructions tab also lists the AGENTS.md files DSH always loads for that scope, read-only. The MCP tab shows MCP servers with their status and tools: check or restart a server, start or stop it globally, or hide its tools in one workspace. Delete moves a skill or rule to the trash after confirmation. Agents can list and switch items with the loadout tool. Rules reach agents whose preset loads AGENTS.md (Minimal does not). Limitation: the / menu of a session whose agent has not started yet still lists Off skills.
